limitations: One M1 Max only; M2-M5 performance unverified.
Historical upstream and Pearly were measured sequentially in matched 600-second windows; latest 180-second trials were later and are not a fresh matched cross-miner A/B.
Upstream historical mean uses overlapping printed rolling windows; Pearly rate denominator is not source-audited.
Older optimized baseline counts may include a just-expired scan; final S path excludes post-scan stale work.
Latest final S run excluded 3145728 of 1331691520 completed tiles as stale (about 0.236%).
Seven accepted shares establish bounded pool acceptance, not long-term income, stability, or a precise pool hashrate.
Research runs did not enable the new release developer-fee schedule.
No wall power or electricity-adjusted profit was measured.
